reviews.genericComment: First of all, nothing beats the convenience… would love to see hourly rates/reservations. Also the water pressure was AMAZING! AC worked well and kept me plenty cool. The hotel needs some serious TLC, especially at these prices. TV was old and gross, needs paint, carpet needs cleaning/replacement. The bedding and towels were garbage. As a 6’2” guy a Twin XL would have been nice so my feet don’t hang off the end.
reviews.author: Jacob

reviews.genericComment: Location was great. No waiting in the humid night for a shuttle pick-up (which last time took a hour) after a coast-to-coast flight. There is a 24 hour Subway in the airport near check-in for food. View was of a block wall about 5 feet away. Hotel is old, but for a pre-night cruise stay it did it's job. Caught a shuttle from the air port to the ship. Price is about $45-50 too high compared to similar properties in the area.
